title: [S14] DESTROY SOLOQ WITH JARVAN IV - UDYSOF Challenger J4!
author: Udysof_OCE

Warwick.summary: He fights you on roughly equal terms, so neither of you has a clear dueling edge.

MonkeyKing.summary: He fills the same role as you but less effectively, so you should outperform him.

Zac.summary: He is weak early, and you can out-pace him in most games.

XinZhao.summary: He is strong in early fights but falls off hard. Play slowly and avoid early fights around him to exploit his decline.

Volibear.summary: His E and Q easily cancel your E-Q combo, and he out-tanks you. His teamfighting is weak and he lacks terrain-based tools.

Vi.summary: She duels well, but if you dodge her Q she loses the one-on-one.

Udyr.summary: Strong early fighter, but he struggles to gank and your E-Q lets you kite him.

Trundle.summary: He can ult you as you engage to steal your tank stats and burst you, but he struggles to chase you through the jungle.

Taliyah.summary: Your ult traps her easily, forcing her to Flash or fight in melee range.

Skarner.summary: He clears fast and counter-ganks well but struggles to make early plays. QSS counters his ult.

Shyvana.summary: Her kit lacks terrain tools and she gets out-pressured hard early.

Shaco.summary: He gets hard to fight later, but his weak early game lets you start red and invade him easily.

Sejuani.summary: Both of you scale with tank stats and bring engage; the better jungler wins.

Rengar.summary: He can fight you in the jungle, but you can easily E-Q away.

RekSai.summary: She can cancel your E-Q and wins early duels. She does not scale especially well but can snowball the matchup heavily.

Rammus.summary: Not a problem early, though he can out-tank you late.

Qiyana.summary: She dodges your abilities easily and can use your ult's walls to bounce her ult stun. Be very careful against Qiyana jungle.

Poppy.summary: She dominates fights: her W cancels your E-Q instantly, she runs you down, stuns you against your own ult walls, and disengages with her ult.

Olaf.summary: He can duel you early but cannot chase you.

Nunu.summary: He must out-pressure you early, or your reliable engage and peel will outscale him.

Nocturne.summary: He poses little threat unless he jumps you in a brush while your Flash is down.

Nidalee.summary: She dodges all your abilities and can hop out of your ult, making her a very hard matchup.

MasterYi.summary: He cannot escape your engage, so catching him out usually means a kill.

LeeSin.summary: His W and Q let him dodge your abilities, and he is strong early and easily outplays you.

Kindred.summary: She chases you easily in the jungle and her ult can negate yours.

Khazix.summary: He hunts you down and takes objectives easily, and his speed and invisibility make him hard to peel.

Kayn.summary: His low early pressure lets you gank freely without being punished.

Karthus.summary: He can farm and outscale you, but he has no answer to your ult.

Ivern.summary: He wants small early leads but your early map pressure denies them.

Hecarim.summary: He is easy to invade, so you can win hard early.

Graves.summary: He beats you in duels, though he does not gank particularly well.

Gragas.summary: A solid counterpick: he scales well and can cancel your E-Q.

Evelynn.summary: She struggles against you. Late game you can ult her to trade ultimates and take her out of fights.

Ekko.summary: His mobility lets him jump around you, making him hard to pin down.

Amumu.summary: His slow early clear gives you a free invade path.
